critical_code_review_comments: staff_wallet.py: iban_full stored plaintext in MongoDB. Comment says 'in production: encrypted'. Consider encrypting at rest BEFORE production (KMS/Fernet). Currently API responses correctly mask via projection exclude.

staff_demo.py /seed: deletes & re-creates demo data every call which is fine for demo but be careful since it also deletes staff_clock_events for demo merchant — confirmed isolated by merchant_id='demo-merchant-bidblitz', won't affect haendler@bidblitz.com.

staff_wallet.py /payout: marks bonus events as wallet_paid BEFORE inserting payout doc → if Stripe Transfer fails after status='failed' is set, events are still marked wallet_paid which could cause inconsistency. Consider transaction or rollback for failed Stripe path.
staff_push.py /preferences: no merchant_id filter in find_one (only staff_id). Works because staff_id is uuid, but for defense in depth consider adding merchant_id filter.
